48.original: Lali-doubtless you've already guessed-ho, but another recording device has arrived from Konogg. Here.

49.original: Far as I can tell, he's sending them at regular intervals. What could the boy be up to?

50.original: Hmph, I could ask you the same. What devious scheme are you plottin'?

51.original: Well, whatever it is, you won't succeed! This is my village, and I'm not lettin' you have your way with it!

52.original: ...Huh? Why did I say that? Why did I feel so angry? F-Forget I said anything...

53.original: As you can see, Glagg's still behaving strangely.

54.original: When I tried talking to him earlier, he all but told me to bugger off. On the face of it, you'd assume he takes exception to what I did at the meeting, but this is a little <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> strange...

55.original: At any rate, this is my problem to deal with, not yours. You just focus on doing your part for the cause, eh?

56.original: You obtain a message from Konogg.

57.original: The message can be viewed in your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Portable Archive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which is available under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
